<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/openapi/reward/rewardRedeemed"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records the final redemption of a reward after a transaction has been completed and
payment accepted. This is the mandatory confirmation step that commits loyalty point
deductions and offer redemptions to the customer's record in Qubriux. Always call this
endpoint after a successful payment — omitting it will leave the customer's points
balance unchanged even though a discount was applied. Pass the same order object used
in the preceding `validateReward` or `applyCoupon` call to ensure consistency. If
the transaction was cancelled or payment failed, do not call this endpoint.
